name: Iridium NEXT
description: 66 operational satellites (plus 9 on-orbit spares) at 780 km in 6 polar planes — second-generation replacement of the original 1998 Iridium fleet. Voice, data, machine-to-machine. Backbone of GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System); your sat-phone in a remote ocean runs through this.
scale_fact: An Iridium 33 satellite collided with derelict Cosmos 2251 at 776 km in 2009 — the first known satellite collision in history.
